name: Properties Unicode Escaper
subtitle: Pick a build mode and run it in a console
note: Output goes to dist/. When it's done the console title says finished or FAILED, with a summary at the end and a sound. Needs Python and PyInstaller.

modes.label: Portable
modes.desc: Single .exe that runs without installing, no console

modes.label: Folder
modes.desc: Unpacked folder with the .exe and its files, faster startup

modes.label: Debug
modes.desc: Unpacked folder with a console window and verbose boot logging

options.label: Open the output folder when it's done
